name: agentille
description: Personal AI coding orchestrator for Claude Code (trigger: /agt). See your agents work: a live band above the prompt and a pixel team deck show every agent's role, model, effort, state and tokens. A routing mod enforces model + effort per role and escalates to Fable only on observed failure. Finished agents wave goodbye and leave. A focus block flags what needs you, and /agt replies get a colored essentials card over a dimmed body. Formations (duel, gauntlet with an adversary agent, relay) for harder work. Project-aware squads (saas, ecommerce, content, immersive) add payments, SEO and performance specialists. Inside Herdr or tmux, executors and Opus-routed reviewers run as routed Claude panes (model, effort and agent definition); subagents elsewhere, workflows for parallel work without a multiplexer, agent teams deprecated (removed in v3.0).
